evidence.title: 〈スピード感なき協業〉日産･ホンダが空費した｢2年間｣の代償…次世代SDVで共同開発も､中国新興メーカーの勢力が急拡大
evidence.body: [e001:f01] 経営統合の破談以降、関係が悪化していた日産自動車とホンダの協業がここに来てようやく具体化した。 [e001:f02] 8月31日、両社は次世代車のSDV（ソフトウェア定義車両）領域で、中核となるECU（電子制御ユニット）や車載OS（基本ソフト）を両社で共通化することで合意した。 [e001:f03] 2029年度以降にそれぞれが投入する新型車に搭載する。 [e001:f04] 近年はスマートフォンのように自動車が購入後も絶えずアップデートされ、車内エンターテインメントや車両制御、ADAS（先進運転支援システム）などさまざまな機能を追加・向上できるようになってきた。 [e001:f05] その中で、ソフトウェアは自動車の価値を決定づける競争の焦点となっている。 [e001:f06] 日産とアライアンスを組む三菱自動車も2社の枠組みに加わることを検討している。 [e001:f07] 車載OSをはじめとしたソフトウェア開発には莫大なコストがかかるものの、3社で年間販売700万台超のスケールメリットを活かせば、投資負担を減らし蓄積できるデータの量を増やせる。 [e001:f08] だが、米テスラや中国の新興メーカーなどの海外勢がSDVや自動運転分野で先行する中で、その歩みは遅れていると言わざるをえない。 [e001:f09] SBI証券の遠藤功治チーフエグゼクティブアナリストは、「提携検討に2年半を費やし、さらに搭載は3年後。 [e001:f10] このスピード感で、10年後に日産とホンダが独立して存在しているかと言われるとはなはだ疑問だ」と言い切る。 [e001:f11] 記事の続きでは、経営統合の破談から今回の合意に至るまでの紆余曲折と、猛威を振るう中国新興メーカーの脅威、そして次期経営陣が直面するシビアな現実に迫ります。 [e001:f12] この記事は有料会員限定です 残り 2072文字 有料会員とは 各タグの フォローボタン をクリックしフォローすると、関連する新着記事をメールで受け取ることができます ニュース最前線 2026/09/04 更新 141 記事。

evidence.title: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援
evidence.body: [e002:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e002:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e002:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e002:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e002:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e002:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e002:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e002:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e002:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e002:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e002:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。

evidence.title: Red Bull signs ex-Aston Martin F1 chief to replace Lambiase
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The position is currently occupied by long-time Max Verstappen race engineer Gianpiero Lambiase, who has already committed to a future move to McLaren as its chief racing officer. [e004:f02] McCullough's signing comes as Red Bull counters the prior managerial exodus on its side - with Adrian Newey, Jonathan Wheatley, Rob Marshall and strategy chief Will Courtenay among those who have moved on in recent years, in addition to Lambiase's aforementioned McLaren move and the expected switch of chief engineer Paul Monaghan to Cadillac. [e004:f03] "We're delighted to welcome Tom to the team at the beginning of 2027 and look forward to the wealth of experience and expertise he will bring to the role," Red Bull said in a brief statement. [e004:f04] A veteran F1 engineer, McCullough is primarily synonymous with Aston Martin's F1 squad and its direct predecessors Force India and Racing Point. [e004:f05] In one of the numerous F1 leadership reshuffles at the outfit, McCullough (pictured below with Aston Martin owner Lawrence Stroll) was shifted from the F1 project to an Aston Martin Performance Technologies role at the start of last year - but he will now return to grand prix racing. evidence.title: Lando Norris launches LN4 Fusion team to develop young drivers in F1 and motorsport
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Named LN4 Fusion it will compete in multiple championships including the feeder series for Formula One, F3 and F2, as [the current F1 world champion](https:// commits to helping young drivers make it to the top level in motorsport. [e003:f02] Norris’s involvement, including a personal financial undertaking alongside an investment group, represents the first time an F1 world champion has directly backed a team in the modern junior single-seater era. [e003:f03] As part of the project he has also established the LN4 Legacy programme, a driver development initiative designed to identify and support talent coming through the ranks from karting upwards and then provide assistance financially as well as in coaching, performance and career support. [The McLaren driver](https:// launched the project at an event in Monza, which will host the Italian Grand Prix this weekend. [e003:f04] It constitutes a serious and comprehensive effort to address some of the difficulties facing junior drivers coming through the ranks, which Norris has previously identified as a fundamental problem for the sport. [e003:f05] LN4 Fusion is about building a race team that can compete with the best in junior motorsport, with great people and a great environment for drivers to develop. [e003:f06] [Image 1: Lando Norris lifts the F1 Championship trophy on the podium at the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix at Yas Marina Circuit ](https:// Lando Norris became the world champion with McLaren in 2025. [e003:f07] Photograph: Clive Mason/Getty Images The intent for the LN4 Fusion team will be to compete in a range of championships as of next year with already confirmed programmes in F3 for 2027, as well as the Italian F4 Championship and the FIA Formula Regional European Championship. [e003:f08] As part of the process the team has acquired key assets from the German team AIX Racing, which has an F3 entry until the end of the 2027 season and has applied for participation in the F2 Championship. [e003:f09] “Seeing [Lando Norris](https:// involved in this new project is an incredible statement on how much the pyramid of Formula 3 and Formula 2 is crucial to the future of Formula One,” he said. [e003:f10] “Through Lando’s investment and experience we can build a future, with new drivers, engineers, mechanics, and a tradition that will be followed by motorsport lovers.” The seriousness of Norris’s ambition was emphasised with the appointment of René Rosin as team principal. [e003:f11] Part of the LN4 Fusion team will be formed from the experience and personnel at the Fusion Motorsport team, which has enjoyed huge success for 25 years in UK karting, with multiple national and more recently international titles. [e003:f12] The head of Fusion Motorsport karting, Dan Hazlewood, will be team principal of the LN4 Fusion UK operation, including overseeing the planned entry into the British F4 championship and in bringing talent through from karting. [skip past newsletter promotion](http:// after newsletter promotion ! [e003:f13] [Image 2: LN4 Fusion’s F3 car side view on a blue background](https:// Lando Norris’s LN4 Fusion F3 car. [e003:f14] Photograph: LN4 Fusion With 2027 set for the opening of racing for the team, the organisation is developing a European headquarters in Veneto, northern Italy with a British base in Cambridgeshire already developing the F4 programme. [e003:f15] “What we have created is far more than simply the acquisition of a racing team,” he said. [e003:f16] “We have assembled a rare combination and secured the right sporting leadership in the industry: an established operation, a Formula One world champion, the most successful team principal in junior single-seater racing over the past two decades, world-class motorsport expertise, significant investment and a shared ambition to build a team capable of competing at the highest levels of the sport.”。

evidence.title: F1 teams agree to shorten race distances to 290 km from 2027
evidence.body: [e005:f01] All 11 teams have backed a proposal to reduce the standard Grand Prix distance by around 5%, but the change still requires formal approval before entering the 2027 regulations News summary All 11 F1 teams have unanimously backed a proposal to reduce the standard Grand Prix distance from 305 km to around 290 km in 2027. [e005:f02] The change is linked to increased internal-combustion engine power and fuel flow , which will raise fuel consumption. [e005:f03] The proposal still needs approval from the F1 Commission and subsequent ratification by the FIA World Motor Sport Council before becoming part of the sporting regulations. [e005:f04] Formula 1 is set to shorten its Grand Prix distances from the 2027 season after all 11 teams backed a proposal to reduce the standard race distance from 305 km to approximately 290 km . [e005:f05] The agreement, first reported by Italian publication AutoRacer and subsequently reported by other outlets, is aimed at addressing the consequences of changes to the 2027 power-unit regulations. [e005:f06] However, the reduction is not yet formally part of the sporting regulations . [e005:f07] However, varying race distances across the calendar could have created unintended consequences, including the risk of some events becoming fuel-economy contests. [e005:f08] The change would effectively cut approximately two to three laps from a typical Grand Prix. [e005:f09] The decision is also intended to avoid forcing teams to make major changes to cars that were designed around the 2026 regulations. [e005:f10] Reducing the race distance provides a simpler solution: cars can consume more fuel per kilometer while still completing the Grand Prix without requiring a significant increase in fuel capacity. [e005:f11] The result could be faster average race pace in 2027 , even though the total distance covered during each Grand Prix will be shorter. [e005:f12] For now, however, the 290 km figure remains a team-backed proposal rather than a formally ratified regulation . [e005:f13] If approved by the F1 Commission and subsequently ratified by the WMSC, it would become part of the 2027 sporting rules. [e005:f14] The 2026 Formula 1 season continues this weekend at Monza, with the Italian GP taking place from September 4-6. [e005:f15] All 11 teams have backed the proposal, but it still needs approval from the F1 Commission and ratification by the FIA World Motor Sport Council. [e005:f16] The change is linked to increased combustion-engine power and higher fuel-flow rates, which are expected to increase fuel consumption.

evidence.body: [e006:f01] これにより、当社はこの最高峰の耐久レースイベントのオフィシャルパートナーとなり、世界のモータースポーツとの結びつきをさらに強固なものにします。 [e006:f02] この複数年にわたる契約を通じて、FAGEは、Le Mans Spirit Clubによる限定の食体験やパドックでのイベントなど、直接的な接点を通じて、拡大を続けるWECファン層に同社の代表的なギリシャヨーグルトシリーズを提供し、レースウィークエンドを通じてファンに上質な味わいをお届けします。 [e006:f03] 「FIA WEC「Lone Star Le Mans」とのパートナーシップは、伝統、職人技、そしてパフォーマンスを深く尊重する2つの組織を結ぶものです」と、FAGEの最高経営責任者（CEO）であるAthanassios Filippouは述べています。 [e006:f04] 」 長きにわたり受け継がれてきた料理の職人技と、味と品質へのこだわりで定評のあるFAGEが、FIA WEC「Lone Star Le Mans」に参画することで、パフォーマンスと卓越性に対する両組織の揺るぎない取り組みが結集することになります。 [e006:f05] FIA世界耐久選手権のマーケティング・コミュニケーション・ディレクターであるMarius Louvet氏は次のように述べています。 [e006:f06] 「Lone Star Le MansのパートナーとしてFAGEを迎え入れることができ、大変嬉しく思います。 [e006:f07] FAGEは、確固たる地位を築き、大きな成功を収めている国際的な消費者向けブランドです。 [e006:f08] 今回の提携は、FIA WECが従来のモータースポーツや自動車業界の枠を超えて関心を集めることができることを明確に示しています。 [e006:f09] 「FAGEは、COTAでのレースウィークエンドを通じて、目に入りやすく、そして肌で感じることができる形で存在感を示します。 [e006:f10] FAGEチームの皆様を当施設にお迎えできることを楽しみにしております。 [e006:f11] FIA WECでは、世界トップクラスの選手たちが激突し、スピード、戦略、エンジニアリング、そして人間のパフォーマンスが試されるなかで、スポーツとしての卓越した技量が発揮される圧巻のスペクタクルが繰り広げられます。 [e006:f12] オフィシャルパートナーとして、FAGEは「Lone Star Le Mans」の会場全体で存在感を示し、会場でのプロモーション活動やファンが楽しめるデジタルコンテンツを通じて、耐久レースの世界的な祭典に参加するとともに、世界選手権の中でも特に個性的なこのイベントに、自社の伝統と食に関する専門知識をもたらします。 [e006:f13] FAGEについて FAGEは、世界中の食通に最高級の乳製品をお届けすることに情熱を注ぐ、業界をリードする乳製品メーカーです。 [e006:f14] 1926年にギリシャで創業したFAGEは、ギリシャ発祥のブランドとして成長を遂げ、現在では30カ国以上で卓越した乳製品を提供しています。 [e006:f15] 代表的なギリシャ風ストレーナーヨーグルトで広く知られるFAGEは、これからも健康的なライフスタイルを提案し、美味しさにこだわった製品をお届けし続けます。 [e006:f16] FAGE X IA WEC Lone Star Le Man （日本語リリース：クライアント提供） PR Newswire Asia Ltd.

evidence.title: フェルスタッペン、レッドブルと再契約しFIAがエンジンを変更
evidence.body: [e009:f01] マックス・フェルスタッペンがレッドブルとの契約延長にサインし、彼の将来に関する数ヶ月にわたる憶測に終止符を打った。 [e009:f02] オランダ人ドライバーは現在のレギュレーションを公然と批判していたが、この合意により疑念は払拭された。 [e009:f03] 一方、FIAは2年後のエンジンバランス調整を発表し、ドメニカリは中東の緊張にもかかわらずカレンダーを確認した。 [e009:f04] チャンピオンの契約安定は、エコシステムにとって安心材料だ。 [e009:f05] 技術調整：FIAがエンジンバランスを再調整 🏎️ FIAが2026年にエンジンバランスを変更する決定は、軽視できるものではない。 [e009:f06] この変更は、現在のレギュレーションに基づいてパワーユニットを設計してきたチームに直接影響を与える。 [e009:f07] フォードとの提携を進めるレッドブルは、開発を新たなパフォーマンスウィンドウに適応させる必要がある。 [e009:f08] エンジニアやストラテジストにとって、このニュースはパワーマップと熱管理の再計算を意味する。 [e009:f09] ドメニカリが確認したカレンダーは物流面でのプレッシャーを増すが、チームにとって大きな驚きはない。 [e009:f10] チャンピオンは残留、しかしエンジンは2年後に変更 🔧 フェルスタッペンは契約を更新し、ついでに別のステアリングを覚える頭痛からも解放された。 [e009:f11] 一方、ホンダとルノーのエンジニアたちは、すでに電卓を片手に、新しいバランスで何馬力失うか、あるいは得るかを計算し始めている。 [e009:f12] ドメニカリはカレンダーを維持すると約束したが、中東ではガソリンがコミッショナーの忍耐よりも高価だ。 [e009:f13] 結局のところ、チャンピオンは勝ち続け、チームは適応し続けるということだ。

evidence.title: Mercedes delays ADUO engine upgrade until October
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Kimi Antonelli, Dutch GP 2026 © Mercedes-Benz Grand Prix Ltd. [e003:f02] Kimi Antonelli will have a fresh Mercedes power unit at Monza, but it will not be the new specification the team is developing under Formula 1's ADUO rules. [e003:f03] The resulting penalty sends him to the back of the grid before the weekend has begun. [e003:f04] Mercedes has one development opportunity under the Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities system, but the revised engine is now expected during the American leg of the championship in October, most likely at Austin or Mexico City. [e003:f05] At first glance, taking a penalty immediately before an upgrade appears to be an expensive way of acquiring an engine which is already becoming obsolete. [e003:f06] The explanation lies in Antonelli's available pool of components rather than in the development calendar. [e003:f07] Reliability problems and terminal failures have reduced the number of usable units available to him. [e003:f08] Mercedes needs to add an engine now simply to cover the remaining mileage, whether or not the performance update is ready. [e003:f09] George Russell has used the same number of components but retains a healthier pool because fewer of his units have been lost completely. [e003:f10] Both Mercedes drivers are nevertheless expected to require six power units over the season, which makes further grid penalties likely. [e003:f11] The engineers must choose where those penalties do the least damage rather than pretending they can avoid them. [e003:f12] Monza is an obvious candidate. [e003:f13] The delay also separates two issues which are easily confused. [e003:f14] The engine going into Antonelli's car this weekend is needed for reliability and mileage; the October specification is intended to recover performance under ADUO. [e003:f15] Mercedes will hope the old specification is strong enough to limit the loss at Monza and that the new one arrives before the championship reaches its decisive stage. [e003:f16] Antonelli's task on Sunday is simpler to describe: pass as many cars as possible without creating another item for the damaged-components list.

evidence.body: [e005:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e005:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e005:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e005:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e005:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e005:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e005:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e005:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e005:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e005:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e005:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。

evidence.title: Starlink Goes Live in the UAE: What the Launch Means
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The UAE becomes one of more than 150 countries and territories where Starlink operates — but this particular market carries some weight beyond the headline number. [e002:f02] Source: @Starlink — September 3, 2026 Source: @elonmusk — September 3, 2026 Two Years in the Making The path to this launch started in June 2024, when the UAE's Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (TDRA) granted Starlink Satellite Communications Services LLC a 10-year General Satellite Services License — valid through June 2034. [e002:f03] The TDRA Director-General, Majed Sultan Al Mesmar, described the license at the time as a move that would significantly enhance the UAE's telecommunications sector and support innovation. [e002:f04] Residential service officially went live on March 18, 2026, meaning the September 3 announcement marks a broader commercial push rather than a soft-launch moment. [e002:f05] Starlink's social confirmation today signals the service has cleared whatever remaining operational hurdles existed before a full public rollout. [e002:f06] Pricing and Hardware According to pricing data reported by Gulf News and Arabian Business, Starlink's UAE plans are structured as follows: Plan Monthly (AED) Approx. [e002:f07] Prospective subscribers in high-demand areas can join a waitlist with a Dh285.71 deposit, which is credited toward the kit price at purchase. [e002:f08] Performance specs sit at 50–200 Mbps download speeds with 20–40ms latency — competitive with fixed-line broadband in many parts of the country, and a significant step up from what satellite internet historically offered in the region. [e002:f09] Emirates has committed to rolling out free Starlink Wi-Fi across its entire fleet of 232 Boeing 777 and A380 aircraft, with the rollout beginning in November 2025 and targeting completion by mid-2027. [e002:f10] The 10-year licensing term also signals regulatory stability that SpaceX can build on for enterprise and government contracts, not just consumer subscriptions. [e002:f11] For Starlink's global trajectory, the UAE launch is incremental rather than transformational on its own. [e002:f12] But the combination of a long-term regulatory framework, an affluent consumer base, and existing aviation partnerships makes it a more commercially meaningful entry than a simple country-count addition. evidence.title: Dragon Oxidizer Leak Grounds Crew-13 as NASA and SpaceX Hunt for a New Launch Date
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Crew Dragon Crew-13 Dragon Falcon 9 Nasa SpaceX Last Updated: September 2, 2026 NASA and SpaceX have slipped off their scheduled departure for the International Space Station after an oxidizer leak turned up in the propulsion system of the Crew-13 Dragon spacecraft — and no replacement date has been penciled in. [e004:f02] Contents What happens between now and a new date Four astronauts, four agencies, one Expedition The hardware, unchanged The leak surfaced while engineers were performing routine spacecraft processing in the lead-up to launch. [e004:f03] It wasn’t caught mid-countdown, and it wasn’t caught during a fueling test. [e004:f04] An oxidizer is the chemical that allows fuel to burn inside a rocket or spacecraft propulsion system, which makes it essential to the vehicle’s ability to maneuver. [e004:f05] What happens between now and a new date Additional testing is underway, with teams from both NASA and SpaceX poring over data from the spacecraft. [e004:f06] Any repairs, or other work deemed necessary, will be wrapped up before Dragon is cleared for flight. [e004:f07] No new target launch date has been announced by NASA. [e004:f08] The agency and SpaceX have said one will be shared once the testing, the data reviews and any required work on the spacecraft are complete. [e004:f09] That is the entirety of the schedule at the moment, and the sequence of those three items rewards a careful read: the date comes after the work, not before it. [e004:f10] Four astronauts, four agencies, one Expedition Crew-13 will be commanded by NASA astronaut Jessica Watkins, with fellow NASA astronaut Luke Delaney serving as pilot. [e004:f11] Joining them as mission specialists are Joshua Kutryk of CSA (Canadian Space Agency) and Roscosmos cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov. [e004:f12] Upon arrival at the station, the four will fold into Expedition 75 — the long-duration crew responsible for research, maintenance and other operations aboard the orbiting laboratory. [e004:f13] Roughly two weeks ahead of the flight, the Crew-13 astronauts enter quarantine at NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston. [e004:f14] It is also yet another element of the timeline that must be re-clocked each time a launch date shifts. [e004:f15] The hardware, unchanged Once the mission gets the green light, Crew-13 will fly aboard SpaceX’s Dragon, the spacecraft designed to ferry astronauts to orbit and back. [e004:f16] Dragon lifts off atop a Falcon 9 from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida .

evidence.title: Chaotic Eclipse Releases Crowdstrike Falcon ZeroDay FalconFlank
evidence.body: [e001:f01] The researcher named the exploit FalconFlank, it triggers a privilege escalation flaw. [e001:f02] According to the researcher, FalconFlank abuses Falcon’s “Microsoft Office file malicious macro removal” feature. [e001:f03] The function is part of Falcon’s remediation capabilities and operates with high privileges. [e001:f04] “FalconFlank is a 0day privilege escalation that abuses the office malicious macros remediation in Crowdstrike Falcon Sensor, obviously by the time I drop this Crowdstrike would already have detections for it so if you want to test you either have to add it to the exclusions or obfuscate the PoC and change the dll load technique.” reads the announcement . [e001:f05] “As of now it works in a fully updated windows 11 25H2 / Windows Server 2025 with Crowdstrike Falcon – Phase 3 Optimal Protection + needs “Microsoft Office file malicious macro removal”” The proof of concept works on fully updated Windows 11 25H2 and Windows Server 2025 systems running CrowdStrike Falcon with Phase 3 – Optimal Protection and the malicious macro removal feature enabled. [e001:f06] An interesting part of the announcement is the researcher’s warning that CrowdStrike may already have detections for the published PoC. [e001:f07] In other words, the underlying vulnerability could still exist even if Falcon detects and blocks the specific exploit technique used in the PoC. [e001:f08] The case is particularly interesting because it highlights a broader security issue: EDR products need elevated privileges to protect a system, but those same privileges can become an attack surface. [e001:f09] An attacker who gains limited local access may try to abuse the security software itself to obtain higher privileges. [e001:f10] Recently, Chaotic Eclipse released exploits targeting other anti-malware solutions. [e001:f11] Chaotic Eclipse released a zero-day exploit targeting Kaspersky Endpoint Security he named HardBreacher , which triggers a privilege escalation flaw. [e001:f12] Nightmare Eclipse says the Kaspersky Endpoint Security zero-day allows privilege escalation on a fully patched Windows 11 25H2 system running Kaspersky Endpoint v14.0.0.504. [e001:f13] The researcher also released a zero-day exploit targeting GenDigital Avast Antivirus, named PrettyPrague . [e001:f14] It reportedly works even on fully patched Avast Antivirus and Windows 11 25H2. [e001:f15] Chaotic Eclipse, also known as Nightmare Eclipse, is a researcher known for publicly releasing PoC exploits for zero-day vulnerabilities, often after criticizing vendors’ handling of vulnerability reports. [e001:f16] His releases have mainly targeted Microsoft products, including Windows and Microsoft Defender, with some later exploited in the wild.

evidence.title: NASA's Roman Telescope Launches on Falcon Heavy: What to Know
evidence.body: [e003:f01] NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope — one of the agency's most ambitious astrophysics missions in years — launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy on August 30, 2026, and is now quietly making its way to one of the most scientifically productive addresses in the solar system. [e003:f02] Avid Space's weekly industry update, posted by @LabPadre on September 2, puts the mission in context alongside other active Falcon 9 activity and Artemis program developments. [e003:f03] Source: @LabPadre — September 2, 2026 The Launch, by the Numbers Detail Value Launch date August 30, 2026 — 7:26 a.m. [e003:f04] EDT Vehicle SpaceX Falcon Heavy Launch site Launch Complex 39A, Kennedy Space Center, Florida Destination Sun-Earth Lagrange Point 2 (L2) Transit distance ~1.5 million km (930,000 miles) Transit duration Approximately three months NASA Falcon Heavy missions to date 4th primary mission Falcon Heavy total engines 27 Merlin engines across three reusable Falcon 9 cores Why L2 — and Why Falcon Heavy L2 is the same gravitational sweet spot that hosts the James Webb Space Telescope. [e003:f05] Sitting roughly 1.5 million kilometers beyond Earth on the Sun-Earth line, it offers an unobstructed, thermally stable vantage point ideal for infrared observation — exactly what Roman needs to survey wide swaths of sky for dark energy signatures, exoplanet atmospheres, and infrared transients. [e003:f06] Getting a payload to L2 requires meaningful delta-v, which is why NASA turned to Falcon Heavy rather than a standard Falcon 9. [e003:f07] The rocket's three-core architecture — essentially three Falcon 9 first stages strapped together — delivers the lift margin that a mission of Roman's mass demands. [e003:f08] According to NASA, this marks the fourth time the agency has used Falcon Heavy as its primary launch vehicle, a pattern that reflects both the rocket's proven reliability and the cost pressure NASA operates under for flagship science missions. [e003:f09] Falcon 9 Activity and the Broader Context The Avid Space update doesn't treat Roman in isolation. [e003:f10] The weekly roundup also covers ongoing Falcon 9 cadence and Artemis program developments — a reminder that SpaceX is simultaneously supporting commercial satellite launches, ISS crew and cargo rotations, and NASA's deep-space human exploration program. [e003:f11] The center core trajectory for a high-energy L2 insertion typically precludes recovery of that stage — the energy budget simply doesn't leave enough propellant for a return burn — though SpaceX has not publicly detailed the exact recovery plan for this particular flight. [e003:f12] What Roman Will Actually Do Named after Nancy Grace Roman, NASA's first Chief of Astronomy, the telescope carries a 2.4-meter primary mirror — the same aperture as Hubble — but with a field of view roughly 100 times larger.
